rows.name: ISLE OF MAY
rows.description: Two stone towers, 78 and 86 ft.; low lt., 750 ft. distant, on N.E. side. In one, S.S.W. ¾ W. leads ½ mile E. of North Carr Rock. Low lt. only visible over 15° towards N. Carr Rock

rows.name: BELL ROCK
rows.character: One revol. light, bright and red alternately, every minute
rows.description: A tower, 117 ft. high; on the Bell Rock, at 10 feet below high water. A bell is sounded every half minute in fogs

rows.name: St. Andrew's
rows.description: Red lt. on the pier-head, and bright lt. on a turret in cathedral wall

rows.name: BUDDONNESS or TAY
rows.description: Two white towers, 104 and 65 ft., 1,300 ft. apart, on the low Ness. In one, N.N.W. ¾ W., lead on to the Abertay Sand. High lt. open N. of low lt., bearing N.W. ¾ N., leads up to entrance

rows.name: Tay River Light-ves.
rows.description: To show a flashing lt. ev. 10 secs., S.E. ½ S. from Buddon Ness high lt.-ho., & N.E. ¾ E. 3½ cables from black buoy No. 3.

rows.name: Port on Craig
rows.description: West, a white tower, 76 ft. East, a pile ltho., 1,700 yds. apart. In one, N.W. by W. ¾ W., lead up the Tay. A fog-bell at the pile ltho.

rows.name: Newport
rows.description: On the West Ferry pier. In one, N.N.E., 63 yards apart

rows.name: Dundee Harbour
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lights 2. Red and bright lts. 3. Two fixed red lights
rows.description: 1. On middle and E. pier. In one, N.W. ¾ W., lead S.W. of Beacon Rock 2. On Ferry pier at Dundee, to lead East of Middle Bank 3. Tide lts. at entrance of Camperdown dock

rows.name: Arbroath
rows.character: 1. One red fixed light 2. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. On the North pier, when vessels enter. An occasional bright flash is a warning to keep off 2. Leading lights West of inner harbour

rows.name: MONTROSE NESS
rows.description: A white brick tower, 127 ft., on South pt. of entrance

rows.name: Montrose Harbour
rows.description: White towers, on the N. side of entrance, 900 feet apart. In one, N.W. by W. ½ W., lead into the river

rows.name: Stonehaven
rows.character: One br., one red fixed lt.
rows.description: East, or low lt., bright. On inner side of harbour. In one, W. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: GIRDLENESS
rows.description: In one tower, 120 ft. high. Fog Whistle for 10 secs. at intervals of 1 minute

rows.name: Aberdeen
rows.character: One bright fixed light Two red (or green) fixed lights Red, white, & green lts.
rows.description: Tide lt., bright, on N. pier-head, from ½-flood to high water. When entr. is safe, the two lts. at Torry are red; when ships cannot enter, green. In one, W. by S., they lead in On pole at head of S. breakwater, 6 ft. apart. Not shown in bad weather, when N. pier lt. is obscured over and 200 yards outside S. breakwater head

rows.name: BUCHANNESS
rows.description: A stone tower, 15 ft., on the Ness. Shown from N. by E. to S.W. by W., by E. and S.

rows.name: Boddom
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lts. 2. Two fixed red lts.
rows.description: 1. About 120 yds. N. of pier of S. harbour. In one lead through E. channel to S. harbour... 2. On wooden bridge and on wooden pier of S. harbour. In one lead through W. channel to S. harbour. Only in fishing season

rows.name: Peterhead
rows.description: Br. lt. on elbow of W. pier in S. harbour; shown to S., betw. S. ¾ E. and S.W. by W. ½ W.; red lt. on W. pier in N. harbour; shown to E., betw. E. ½ N. and N.E. ½ N.

rows.name: Fraserburgh
rows.description: On pier-head and middle pier. In one, S.E. by E., 228 ft. apart; from July to April

rows.name: KINNAIRD HEAD
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: A stone tower, 76 ft. high. Light red over Rattray Brigs, westward of S.S.E. ¾ E.
